title: In My Life

sections.name: Intro
sections.note: Lennon's riff over A–E. Two bars of it also come after the first bridge.

sections.name: Verse
sections.bars: A E | F#m A7 | D Dm | A

sections.name: Bridge
sections.bars: F#m | D | G | A | F#m | B7 | Dm | A

why: The **borrowed iv minor** (D → Dm) and **♭VII** (G in A) — two sounds the Beatles used everywhere — plus F♯m as an E-shape barre.
hard_change: **F♯m barre → A7 → D → Dm**, all inside two bars. Practise D → Dm alone first: only the top string moves (2 → 1).
theory: iv (Dm) and ♭VII (G) are borrowed from A minor; A7 is V/IV; B7 is V/V.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: F♯m → A7 → D → Dm → A.
With the record. The third verse is the instrumental (piano) verse; the outro is the intro riff, the bridge's second line, then the riff again.
